text: 深交所：2026年9月7日至9月11日，本所共对92起证券异常交易行为采取了自律监管措施，涉及盘中拉抬打压、虚假申报等异常交易情形；共对7起上市公司重大事项进行核查，并上报证监会5起涉嫌违法违规案件线索。
text_en: Shenzhen Stock Exchange: From September 7 to September 11, 2026, the Exchange took self-regulatory measures against a total of 92 cases of abnormal securities trading, involving abnormal trading situations such as intraday ramping up and suppressing and false declarations; conducted verification on a total of 7 major matters of listed companies and reported 5 clues on suspected illegal and non-compliant cases to the CSRC.
